title: European Shopify merchant introductions
criteria: One free worked example and five additional European Shopify merchant profiles, each with a published business contact, cross-border shipping, actual language observations and a tailored catalogue translation comparison.
geography: Netherlands and Belgium; merchants serving cross-border buyers

leads.business_need: The Shopify storefront sells vintage furniture and contemporary designs. It shows new arrivals and a sold archive; the shop also sources replacement stock across Europe. The delivery guide covers Belgium, wider Europe and overseas freight, with quotes for larger pieces.
leads.contact_instructions: Published shop email: hello@fussypeople.eu. General contact and delivery questions use the same address: https://www.fussypeople.eu/pages/faq .
leads.geography: Amsterdam, Netherlands; European and worldwide delivery
leads.why_it_fits: A useful pilot is one newly listed item in French or German, carrying over designer names, dimensions, condition notes and the correct shipping-quote instructions. Review its product text, URL and search description, then change one source detail to check the update. Current pages were read in English; ask which other storefront languages and translation apps are already in use. Keep the existing catalog and shipping process.
leads.opening_message: Your new-arrivals catalog and EU delivery service make a focused language demo possible: one furniture listing, its condition notes and its shipping-quote instructions in French or German. Would a side-by-side review against your current storefront be useful?
leads.status_note: Shopify footer, published shop email, new-arrivals catalog and international delivery information checked on 13 October 2026.
